name: Neon

identity.oneLiner: 80s synthwave: perspective grid, striped sunset sun, chrome type, neon tubes.
identity.summary: Neon/Synthwave is high-contrast dark-first romance: perspective grid floor, striped sunset sun, wireframe mountains, chrome type, wedge neon tubes, and scanlines. Glow is decoration only — contrast must pass without it. Light mode is a Miami dusk pink sky with saturated magenta/cyan accents.
identity.authenticityNotes: Grid + sun + chrome type + glow tubes beat rainbow dashboards. One horizon plane per hero; never fixed page-wide.

axes.shape: Wedge 45° corner cuts; squared chrome bezels
axes.edge: 2px neon tube with layered outer glow
axes.surface: Indigo night lacquer (dark) or Miami dusk pink (light); scanline overlay
axes.elevation: Hard neon rim + dark drop; bloom is cosmetic
axes.ornament: Perspective grid, striped sun, wireframe mountains, scanlines
axes.typeVoice: Chrome/Monoton for H1; Orbitron for headings; Mr Dafoe script overlay; Exo 2 for UI
axes.motion: Optional RGB-split on chrome hover; respect reduced motion
axes.density: Showy marketing density; tighten for app chrome

bands.description: Structure hints only: radius, type voice, subtle edge. No ornaments.
Clear era geometry and materials; sparse ornaments on surfaces. Alias: signature.
Full decorative program. Demo/showcase territory; neverDo still binds. Applied when data-fidelity-band is absent.

neverDo: Glow never counts toward WCAG contrast — text/icons must pass on flat fills.
Never put Orbitron on Button/TextField/Switch labels.
Never stack multiple full-bleed grids; one backdrop plane per view.
Never use pure #ff00ff on pure #00ffff for small text.

lines: type: Monoton chrome + Orbitron + Mr Dafoe + Exo 2
fidelity: costume default; bands whisper|standard|costume (default deprecated alias of standard)

button.shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ew-color-border-subtle) 80%, transparent), 0 0 12px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ew-color-action-bg) 35%, transparent)
button.bevel: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklch, white 35%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in oklch, black 35%, transparent)

card.raisedShadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ew-color-border-strong), 0 0 28px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ew-color-action-bg) 40%, transparent), 0 16px 40px color-mix(in oklch, black 55%, transparent)
